<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z 194.09 (100 %). The next peak at +2 Da (m/z 196.08) has ~33 % intensity, which matches the characteristic isotopic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 3:1). No other element shows a clear, diagnostic pattern (e.g., bromine would give a ~1:1 M+2, sulfur’s isotopic contributions are much smaller). Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
